ProductApprovalOutput.description: The approval record, as echoed by compile/status output.

snapshot_path.description: Project-root-relative path of the immutable snapshot file.

ProductArtifactOutput.description: One emitted artifact, as reported by `rocky product compile`.

approval.description: The current approval record, when one exists. Compile is a READER of the approval: when present, the snapshot bytes were re-verified against the record digest before this output was produced.

artifacts.description: The artifacts this phase committed (manifest excluded).

manifest_path.description: Project-root-relative path of the committed lowering manifest.

phase.description: Which lowering phase this run committed: `lowered_contract` (Phase A) or `merged` (Phase B).

spec_digest.description: `sha256:<hex>` over the compiled spec's raw bytes.

spec_matches_approval.description: Whether the compiled spec's digest equals the approved digest. `null` when no approval exists. `false` is not an error at compile time — it means the working spec has moved past the approval (the loop's supersession trigger).
